From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:02:15 -0800
Subject: Internal: quicksafe Nov19 — triage notes

Quick triage notes (summary of what ops/eng found so far):
- Timeline: 08:44 PST sudden spike in queue latency on a subset of host groups; controller attempted scale-up but some requests were routed to a newly provisioned pool where a model variant mismatch caused KV-cache miss amplification.
- Root immediate cause: a race in the autoscaler + model-deploy pipeline that allowed a model-variant tag to be served before KV cache warming completed. That resulted in repeated cold-cache lookups and backpressure at the inference shard, causing p99 token latencies to spike and some requests to time out.
- Secondary contributor: our gateway retry policy and client-facing defaults allowed two client retries within the outage window; that increased load and helped propagate timeouts into duplicate downstream work.

Actions we are recommending in the draft now:
1) Hotfix: enforce atomic model-variant flip that blocks routing until cache warm completes (patch in staging, roll to prod by EOD 11/22). Owner: Dylan Brooks (INF-4278).
2) Gateway change: immediate reduce client retry amplification by capping retries during health events + add jitter. Owner: Hannah Schmitt.
3) Metrics/alerts: add variant-cold-cache rate, model-routing-errors, and a p99 token latency alert tied to autoscaler events. Owner: Grace O'Connor.
4) Runbook update: add explicit pre-warm verification step in the deployment play and an escalation checklist for cross-region failover. Owner: Platform Runbook team.

I started a draft post-incident doc (postmortem_draft_quicksafe_v1.pdf) with timeline and preliminary evidence. Please add technical notes and any test results you want included.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Service incident summary and remediation plan — Nov 19 timeout event

Hi Samir — attaching our formal incident summary and a concise action ledger. Thank you for your patience while we validated the fix. Below is an executive summary and the full timeline + owner commitments are attached.

Executive summary (short):
- Impact: Between 08:45 and 09:02 PST on Nov 19, 2026, Quicksafe experienced elevated 5xx/timeouts for approximately 14% of API requests routed to one of our host pools. Some jobs retried and produced duplicate downstream calls. No data exfiltration or customer data corruption was detected.
- Root cause: a race condition between our autoscaling controller and the model deployment pipeline allowed a model variant to begin serving before the model's KV cache warmed. Cold-cache behavior amplified request latencies and led to timeouts. The default gateway retry policy amplified load during the window.
- Fix deployed: We rolled the hotfix that enforces atomic model-variant activation (blocks routing until pre-warm verification passes) and tightened gateway retry behavior. The fix was deployed to production in the primary region on 11/22 at 18:10 PST and verified by end-to-end checks.

Timeline (high level):
- 2026-11-19 08:44 PST: uptick in queue latency on host group A.
- 08:45–09:02 PST: p95/p99 token latencies spike; 14% of calls timed out.
- 09:12 PST: emergency traffic steering to healthy region.
- 11/20–11/22: engineering investigation and reproducible test in staging.
- 11/22 18:10 PST: hotfix roll (atomic activation + gateway retry cap) deployed.
- 11/23 15:40 PST: verification test suite completed against Quicksafe representative traces.

Remediation action ledger (owners and due dates):
- INF-4278 (Dylan Brooks): atomic model-variant activation (deployed 11/22) — verification tests completed 11/23.
- Gateway retry policy changes (Hannah Schmitt): applied runtime cap during health events — live 11/22; follow-up tuning by 12/06.
- New alerts (Grace O'Connor): variant-cold-cache rate and model-routing mismatch alerts — in monitoring 11/24; full runbook integrations by 12/03.
- Runbook update (Platform Runbook): pre-warm verification step + cross-region failover checklist — PR opened; target merge 12/01.

Customer impact remediation and next steps:
- We will run a joint verification test with Quicksafe on 11/24 at 10:00 PST (calendar invite / link: https://meetings.example.com/verify-20261124). Please confirm attendees.
- As a gesture of goodwill we are issuing a service credit equivalent to one week of usage for the affected pool; our billing team will follow up with details.
- We will share the final confirmed post-incident document and evidence bundle (attachment) and keep the ticket INF-4278 open until 12/10 for any verification questions.

Attachments included: postmortem_draft_quicksafe_v1.pdf (full timeline & evidence), remediations_checklist.csv, debug_logs_20261119.tar.gz
